children: Sylvamo’s net sales declined year over year, while its continuing-operations net income rose. Lower volume, primarily following termination of the Riverdale mill supply agreement, outweighed favorable pricing, mix and foreign exchange; higher operating and input costs also pressured results. A Europe-segment impairment drove a consolidated net loss.
¹ Reported as “NET SALES”. ² Reported as “NET INCOME (LOSS)”. ³ Reported as “Net earnings (loss)”.
: Sales fell $36 million; lower volume, mainly from the Riverdale supply agreement termination, was partly offset by higher price and mix.
: Sales rose $30 million on higher volumes, price and mix, and favorable foreign exchange; operating profit fell $11 million on higher costs.
: Sylvamo committed to sell its Europe segment and recorded a $342 million after-tax impairment charge in the quarter.
: The company invested $156 million in capital expenditures in the first nine months of 2026 and expects about $105 million on high-return projects in 2026.
